## Triage: first grade, `priority:p3` · `domain:services` · `area:files` · `pm:blocked` (`finding` removed). Direction: the same 409 that PR #22216 gives, asked before the write

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T07:11Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/services/service-storage` (`storage-routes.ts`'s chunk door and `expireIfPastDeadline`; `metadata-store.ts` `updateSession`) ⇒ `domain:services`; rationale: `packages/services/*` is that lane's.

Blocked-by: #22175

- **Why blocked:** the same file as PR #22216 (#22175, draft). That PR adds the store-side question (`organizationOutOfWriteReach`) these two doors should ask, so claim after it lands, as the card says.
- **Why p3:** it is the same family and the same grade as #22175. It needs an organization switch in the middle of an upload. The wrong part is the answer, which diagnoses a data-engine outage that is not there.
- ⛔ No change to which organization owns an upload (#22046's ruling). ⛔ No catch-all that would hide a real engine failure.

## Unlock: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. #22175 closed, and the store-side question this card reuses is on `main`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T08:07Z. Unlock scan. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Thread-read: 6054616896

- **#22175** closed `completed` at 2026-10-08T07:54Z, through the merge of PR #22216 (`7ebbc014a4`). That PR adds `organizationOutOfWriteReach`, the store-side question the chunk door and `expireIfPastDeadline` should ask before their writes.
- **The serial constraint is cleared:** `storage-routes.ts` has no other open claim in this family. Re-read the in-flight claims at claim time.
- **Direction unchanged:** answer 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the organization change, as PR #22216 does, with one operator warn. ⛔ No catch-all.

Claim: PM loop round 3 · 2026-10-08T08:39Z
Session: `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ`
Account: `os-bill` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22218-chunk-progress-org-change`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22218`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#1` (seat post #6021)
File surface at `origin/main` `3ae59661`, per triage `6054616896` and the unlock `6055582342`:
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`:
  - the chunk door (`PUT …/upload/chunked/:uploadId/chunk/:chunkIndex`, near `:717`);
  - `expireIfPastDeadline` (near `:461`), as reached from the progress door.

  Each asks `requireStartingOrganization` (near `:400`; `organizationOutOfWriteReach` from PR #22216) before its scoped write. A mismatch answers the same `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with the same operator warn.
- Tests in `service-storage` and the organizations wall test beside PR #22216's, plus one `@objectstack/service-storage` `patch` changeset.
  - The pins: both doors on the wall.
  - The control: a same-organization chunk and expiry answer as today, and a real engine failure still answers `500`.

Exclusions:
- ⛔ No change to which organization an upload belongs to.
- ⛔ No catch-all.
- ⛔ No `packages/spec`.
- ⛔ No new error code.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `this repository's own code: the chunk door and the progress door's expiry stamp write by id under the acting organization and report the scoped miss as a data-engine outage | none: PR #22216 added the store-side question at the two other doors only | an uploader who switches active organization mid-upload; measured on the organization wall by objectstack-ai/objectstack#22175's dev`
Thread-read: 6055582342
Serial constraints cleared: PR #22216 landed (`7ebbc014`). Of the open PRs (each file list read), none touches `service-storage/src`.

## Seat ACCEPT: PR #22251 at `c26b15c3` · seat `domain:services#1` (#6021) · `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ` · 2026-10-08T09:23Z

Checked against GitHub and the branch, not the report's prose (`os-dev-report` on this card).

- **Form:**
  - The PR is a draft against `main`. Its first line is `Fixes #22218`, with a line-start `Clause-②: no`. The PR assignee is `os-bill`.
  - Four files: `storage-routes.ts`, the unit file and the wall file beside PR #22216's, and one changeset. +375/−28.
  - No `packages/spec` path and no new code, so no contract review is owed. The PR is not governed.
  - It merges clean with `main`.
- **Diff, read by the seat:**
  - The chunk door asks `requireStartingOrganization(writeContext, [session], 'chunk', …)` after the resume-token check, and before the expiry stamp, the backend `uploadChunk` and the progress write. A refused chunk no longer reaches the backend.
  - The progress door asks only when `expiryStampDue` says the stamp is due, after the uploader rule. `expireIfPastDeadline` is split into `expiryStampDue` and `stampExpired`, and its composition at the other two doors is unchanged.
  - The 409 constants and the operator warn are the ones PR #22216 added. `organizationOutOfWriteReach` answers both writes, so `metadata-store.ts` is untouched.
- **Two calls inside the ruling, both accepted:**
  - **The resume token stays first at the chunk door.** That door has no uploader rule (#22046's ruling covers the other three), and adding one would be outside the fence.
  - **The progress door asks only when it is about to write.** Asking on every call would turn today's `200` read into `409`, an accept-set narrowing against the ruled `Clause-②: no`. It would also break PR #22216's "UNCHANGED — the progress door still answers the uploader" wall pin. Ablation leg C pins the choice.
- **A bounded in-place test fix, accepted.** PR #22216's seed helper defaulted an `undefined` session organization to `org_a`, so its org-less case did not test what it said. The helper now takes `null`, and all three org-less cases assert their premise. It is the same file, the same family and in the fence, and the PR body names it.
- **Changeset, checked sentence by sentence:** the title, the "used to answer `500`" paragraph, **Now** (including "before the chunk reaches the storage backend" and "only when the expiry stamp is due"), every **Unchanged** item, and the remedy line. Each matches the diff. It is one `@objectstack/service-storage` `patch`. It sits beside PR #22216's changeset, which lists the progress door under Unchanged; both are true of their own change, and the PR's Acceptance notes say so.
- **Evidence:**
  - Before, on the wall at base: both negative pins `500` with the outage text. After: `409`, the session unchanged, and switching back lands the chunk and the stamp.
  - Same-organization controls are `200`. A same-organization engine failure still answers `500` at both doors.
  - Ablations A, B and C were each red as predicted, each restored to the HEAD blob.
  - service-storage 717/717 and organizations 151/151. Typecheck passes for both.
  - 68/68 derived gates, plus the error-envelope families beyond the derivation.
- **Landing to-do:**
  - `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` must be `success` on the current head, with every other check green or an expected skip.
  - Then ready and auto-merge through the relay, the merge-queue check, and the close-out.

**Landed** · `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ` · 2026-10-08T10:13Z.

PR #22251 merged through the merge queue as `3513ac77`. On `origin/main`, `service-storage`'s `storage-routes.ts`:
- the chunk door asks `requireStartingOrganization` before the chunk reaches the backend;
- the progress door asks it when the expiry stamp is due (`expiryStampDue` / `stampExpired`).

All four upload doors now answer an organization change with `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, not an outage `500`. The PR's `Fixes` line closed the card `completed`. This note also removes `pm:dispatched` and the assignee.
- The family is closed: objectstack-ai/objectstack#22175 (PR #22216) and this card cover every scoped write the upload doors issue.
